name: Camera Deputaților
notes: 330 seats, 2024-2028 legislature (first sitting 21 December 2024). Who sits, their group and constituency are from the Chamber of Deputies' own alphabetical list (cdep.ro, which carries both chambers); affiliated members count with their group, and 'Independent' means unaffiliated. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
